F03_1_1.name: ForceAggregator
F03_1_1.desc: Computes the net force acting on an object by summing environmental constants like gravity with external inputs like drag or thrust.

F03_1_2.name: VelocityIntegrator
F03_1_2.desc: Converts the aggregated net force into acceleration and updates the object's velocity vector accordingly for the current time step.

F03_1_3.name: PositionIntegrator
F03_1_3.desc: Applies the updated velocity to determine the final spatial coordinates, advancing the object's position through the simulation space.

F03_2_1.name: SpatialGridQuery
F03_2_1.desc: Optimizes collision checks by retrieving only the relevant static tiles surrounding an entity's bounding box, filtering out non-solid geometry.

F03_2_2.name: IntersectionAnalyzer
F03_2_2.desc: Calculates the precise overlap depths and collision normals between an entity's volume and the retrieved candidate tiles.

F03_2_3.name: PenetrationSolver
F03_2_3.desc: Resolves detected overlaps by adjusting the entity's position to the nearest valid surface and cancelling velocity components along the collision normal.

F03_2_4.name: SurfaceModifier
F03_2_4.desc: Applies specific behavioral logic for special tile types, such as ignoring collisions for one-way platforms when approaching from below or handling slope sliding.

F03_3_1.name: GroundingValidator
F03_3_1.desc: Detects and verifies physical contact between entities and platforms to determine eligibility for synchronization, distinguishing between grounded standing and incidental collision.

F03_3_2.name: KineticTransferEngine
F03_3_2.desc: Calculates and applies the platform's velocity vectors to the passenger entity, handling momentum inheritance and dampening to ensure smooth movement.

F03_3_3.name: RelativeSpaceTransformer
F03_3_3.desc: Manages the conversion of entity coordinates between global world space and the platform's local reference frame to maintain precise positional alignment during rotation or translation.

F03_3_4.name: MountLifecycleManager
F03_3_4.desc: Handles the state transitions of entities boarding or disembarking platforms, ensuring clean entry and exit events while preventing physics glitches during dismount.

F07_1_1.name: CollisionSensor
F07_1_1.desc: Monitors spatial overlap between player avatars and gem entities to detect potential collection opportunities.

F07_1_2.name: OwnershipValidator
F07_1_2.desc: Enforces specific interaction rules, verifying that FireBoy targets red gems and WaterGirl targets blue gems while rejecting mismatches.

F07_1_3.name: CollectionExecutor
F07_1_3.desc: Manages the successful collection process by removing the gem entity from the scene and triggering associated score updates.

F07_2_1.name: GemInventoryManager
F07_2_1.desc: Persists and manages the mutable state of collected gems, ensuring distinct counts for each character profile.

F07_2_2.name: CompletionCalculator
F07_2_2.desc: Evaluates the difference between current inventory levels and level-specific targets to determine remaining requirements.

F07_2_3.name: LevelThresholdProvider
F07_2_3.desc: Supplies the goal definitions representing the total gem count required for each specific level.

F07_2_4.name: CollectionEventProcessor
F07_2_4.desc: Handles incoming signals of gem acquisition, validates them against game rules, and triggers state updates.

F07_3_1.name: CompletionScorer
F07_3_1.desc: Calculates the raw percentage of collected gems relative to the level's total capacity to quantify player performance.

F07_3_2.name: TierClassifier
F07_3_2.desc: Maps the calculated completion score against defined ranking thresholds (e.g., 100% for Perfect, <100% for Standard) to determine the clear status.

F07_3_3.name: IntegrityVerifier
F07_3_3.desc: Validates that the submitted collection state contains only legitimate gem identifiers belonging to the current level context.
